title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks shared by the published and owner schemas. Not a file schema itself.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/London local date). Never a time of day.
date.x-error: is not a valid date (expected YYYY-MM-DD)

utcTimestamp.description: A UTC timestamp, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Only pipeline bookkeeping uses these, never run data.
utcTimestamp.x-error: is not a valid UTC timestamp (expected YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

runId.description: Opaque public run ID: the run's local date plus 4 random base32 characters. Never a provider activity ID.
runId.x-error: is not a run ID (expected YYYY-MM-DD-xxxx, copied from the run page URL)

slug.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, e.g. brighton-2027.
slug.x-error: is not a valid id (use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. brighton-2027)

text.description: Free text: non-empty, with no leading or trailing whitespace.
text.x-error: must not be empty or start/end with spaces

timeString.description: An owner-entered duration, h:mm:ss or mm:ss (e.g. 3:30:00, 44:59).
timeString.x-error: is not a valid time (expected mm:ss or h:mm:ss)

distanceName.x-error: is not a known distance (expected 1k, 1mi, 3k, 5k, 10k, 15k, 10mi, 20k, half, 30k, marathon, or metres)

distance.description: A named distance or a distance in metres.
distance.x-error: is not a known distance (expected 1k, 1mi, 3k, 5k, 10k, 15k, 10mi, 20k, half, 30k, marathon, or metres)

url.x-error: is not a valid link (expected https://...)

goalMetric.description: Health metrics a goal or a health exclusion can name. Weight and body fat are judged on the 7-day average.

ownerSchemaVersion.description: Optional in owner files; defaults to the current version.

publishedSchemaVersion.description: Required in published files. A breaking change bumps it and ships a migration.
